logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

north.notes: North wall uses a top rim and underside. It is generated from exposed north floor edges. Junction resolution may promote a hanging face over doorway spans.

south.covered_sections: Every occupied section with an exposed south edge.
south.notes: The south rim crosses the actor anchor of the exposed floor section.

west.covered_sections: Every occupied section with an exposed west edge.
west.notes: The west inner face crosses the actor anchor of the exposed floor section.

composition.opaque: Foreground wall remains visible and the logical entity is marked hidden.
composition.xray: Entity glyph replaces the foreground wall glyph using dim or gray styling while wall metadata remains.
composition.walls_removed: Removing south/west foreground layers reveals the unchanged floor topology and actor anchors.

confirmed_fixtures.purpose: Actor anchor and zero lattice intersections.
Approved north/east background and south/west foreground projection with occlusion.
Approved concave east/south transitions, west/south foreground projection, and incomplete lattice suppression.
Mirrored concave courtyard walls terminating into an interior bridge rim and hanging face.
A single concave inner east wall terminating into a bridge that continues to the exterior east cap.
A bridge beginning at the exterior west edge and terminating into one concave inner west wall.
Two rooms joined by continuous walkable floor. The upper doorway span intentionally uses the approved hanging junction face while the lower corridor edge retains its foreground wall.
Upper and lower rooms joined by a one-section-wide, three-section-long passage. The literal doorway transitions are approved; west is foreground and east is background.
Left and right rooms joined horizontally with one south branch descending into a lower room.

open_work: Approve the three-room south-branch T-junction transitions.
Approve multi-level and nested irregular junctions beyond the current L-shape, bridge, and corridor motifs.
Define raised-platform projection using the same topology/layer pipeline.

north_run.description: A contiguous exposed north-edge run shares one top rim and one capped underside.

west_foreground_run.description: A contiguous exposed west-edge run crosses the actor anchor and alternates actor and boundary rows.

concave_east_start.description: An east wall beginning below continuous floor uses a curved inner start before continuing as |/|.

south_foreground_run.description: A contiguous exposed south run crosses actor anchors; its face start depends on whether the run begins at the exterior west edge or at a concave notch.

courtyard_bridge_junction.description: An interior north run flanked by opposing inner walls repaints its rim above them and hangs one foreground face into the courtyard.
courtyard_bridge_junction.detection: Exposed east edge immediately left, exposed west edge immediately right, and empty courtyard cells above the north run.
courtyard_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: Both inner wall caps terminate into the bridge and are cleared beneath its underside.

one_sided_bridge_junction.description: An interior north run with one terminating inner east wall uses the left half of the courtyard bridge face and retains the exterior east cap.
one_sided_bridge_junction.detection: Exposed east edge immediately left, empty notch cells above, and an exposed east edge at the run’s rightmost floor section.
one_sided_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: The single inner wall cap terminates into the bridge and is cleared beneath its underside.

mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.description: An interior north run beginning at the exterior west edge uses the right half of the courtyard bridge and terminates into one inner west wall.
mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.detection: Exposed west edge at the run’s first floor section, empty notch cells above, and an exposed west wall immediately right.
mirrored_one_sided_bridge_junction.side_wall_resolution: The single inner west wall cap terminates into the bridge and is cleared beneath its final slash.

horizontal_corridor_junction.description: A one-section-high passage between two rooms remains semantically distinct from a courtyard but intentionally reuses the hanging upper junction face.
horizontal_corridor_junction.detection: An interior north run with matching upper and lower east/west side-wall segments, empty cells above and below the passage span, and a matching exposed south run one logical row below.
horizontal_corridor_junction.north_wall_resolution: Join the upper doorway walls with the curved rim and the hanging ‘/___.../ face.
horizontal_corridor_junction.south_wall_resolution: Retain the ordinary foreground south rim and face.

vertical_corridor_junction.description: A one-section-wide passage between upper and lower rooms retains the approved literal doorway and paired wall transitions.
vertical_corridor_junction.detection: Paired exposed west/east runs around one occupied column, continuous floor connections above and below, and matching room-wall segments on both sides of each doorway opening.
vertical_corridor_junction.actor_occlusion: Every corridor section is occluded by its exposed west wall only.
vertical_corridor_junction.visual_resolution: Preserve the literal upper doorway, lower doorway, and paired west/east wall transitions exactly.

south_branch_t_junction.description: A three-section horizontal junction span has one occupied branch column continuing south into a vertical corridor.
south_branch_t_junction.detection: An exposed north run flanked by inner east/west walls, exactly one occupied section immediately below the run, and exposed south edges on every non-branch section.
south_branch_t_junction.branch_center: The branch column is stored explicitly as branch_x.
south_branch_t_junction.vertical_termination: The vertical corridor reports top_termination=t_junction and bottom_termination=lower_room.
south_branch_t_junction.actor_occlusion: The junction section is unobscured; descending branch sections are occluded by the west wall only.
south_branch_t_junction.visual_resolution: Preserve the literal composition pending approval of the center and lower doorway transitions.
